AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-16-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Vicki Gross.
Petitioner: Amber S. Wheeler, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Armane Sofara Kone, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Armane Sofara Wheeler-Kone.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-23-2007 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: P. Van Steenberge.
Petitioner: Amber S. Wheeler, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Armane Sofara Kone, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
Without the proof of service on notice to minor's father, matter is ordered off-calendar.
Petitioner to file an Amended OSC with the new hearing date, and serve the minor's father by MAIL.
The Court waived the re-publication requirement.
AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME

Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patricia VanSteenberge.
Petitioner: Amber Wheeler, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Armane Sofara Kone, was sworn and examined.
